subject: Brightcart: Executive war-room — throughput spike & error budget
messages:
From: Aisha Kumar <aisha.k@brightcart.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.example
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 08:02:12 -0700
Subject: Re: production errors — Brightcart checkout 5xx spike

Jonas,

We just saw a sharp jump in 5xx errors across checkout endpoints starting ~07:52 PT. Latency P95 shot from 120ms to 1.2s and error rate rose to ~4.8% (historical <0.2%). Traffic volume is nominal compared to weekend baseline — looks like a service-side resource contention. Attached is a short sample of application traces and an error snippet.

Impact: Checkout failures for ~28% of logged transactions in the last 10m. Customers are reporting lost orders.

Can you confirm you're seeing the same on your side? We need an immediate bridge and an ETA for stabilization.

Thanks,
Aisha Kumar
Sr SRE, Brightcart

Attachments: error-sample.log (text, 46KB)
From: jonas_weber@redwood.example
To: Aisha Kumar <aisha.k@brightcart.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.example, monica_patel@redwood.example, karthik_iyer@redwood.example
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 08:17:03 -0700
Subject: Re: production errors — Brightcart checkout 5xx spike

Aisha —

Thanks for the heads up and for the logs. We're seeing the same telemetry on our side (P95 latency and elevated 5xx). I'm standing up an executive war-room now and will pull infra and platform leads into a 15-minute bridge.

Immediate asks for your team:
- Confirm whether there were any recent model config changes or rollout windows starting 07:30–08:00 PT.
- Traffic profile for the last 30m (QPS by route) and any anomalous header values if present.

What we'll do in the next 15 minutes:
- Assign roles (Commander, Infra lead, Customer liaison).
- Check KV cache hit rates and model variant routing.
- Consider fallback to a lighter model variant and enable aggressive prefix caching to reduce token compute.

I'll send a calendar invite to the bridge and a brief readout in 20 minutes. Apologies for the disruption — we treat this as highest priority.

— Jonas Weber
Director, Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.example

Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 08:22:41 -0700
Subject: Exec war-room: Brightcart — roles & immediate checklist

Team —

I will take commander duties for this event and drive comms externally. Karthik, you are infra lead: take control of the pool scaling and kernel allocation. Monica, you are customer liaison — keep Aisha and Raj updated and collect run-rate metrics they give us. Jonas, keep leadership looped and own the decision on SLA remediation if stabilization takes > 2 hours.

Immediate checklist (attach exec-warroom-checklist.pdf):
- Snapshot: collect last 20 minutes of model QPS, cache hit ratio, GPU utilization, eviction rates.
- Mitigation: 1) route traffic to smaller model variant, 2) activate prefix/KV caching, 3) increase dedicated pool by +2 nodes if headroom available.
- Communications: prepare short external note for customers and the CSM.

I've attached a short checklist and will run a 15-minute cadence until we see P95 return below 300ms and error rate <0.5%.

Laura Bennett
SVP, Global Ops | Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.example
To: laura_bennett@redwood.example, jonas_weber@redwood.example, monica_patel@redwood.example
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 08:40:55 -0700
Subject: RE: Exec war-room: Brightcart — roles & immediate checklist

Quick telemetry dump and initial hypothesis:
- Observed a burst of small, malformed prompt requests hitting the checkout reranker at ~07:50 PT. QPS increased from 220 -> 1,400 for that micro-route for ~4 minutes.
- KV cache eviction rate jumped to 98% for the session keyspace (likely full-cache eviction on node restart).
- GPU CPU steal and context switch rates spiked; some model instances reported repeated OOM retries.

Mitigations applied at 08:30 PT (on my go):
- Disabled the new reranker variant routing (rolling back to stable variant).
- Forced prefix caching on checkout routes and flushed suspect session keys.
- Temporarily increased Dedicated pool from 6 -> 8 nodes (2x g5xlarge equivalents) to absorb the load.

Prelim result (08:38 PT): P95 down to ~430ms, error rate to ~1.9%. Still above target but trending in right direction. Pushing telemetry snapshot to shared drive.

-- Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: jonas_weber@redwood.example
To: Aisha Kumar <aisha.k@brightcart.com>, Raj Malhotra <raj@brightcart.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.example, karthik_iyer@redwood.example, monica_patel@redwood.example
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Brightcart — 09:05 PT executive status & next steps

Aisha / Raj —

Short update from the executive war-room: we identified a high-frequency malformed prompt pattern routed to the checkout reranker that caused cache thrash and instance memory pressure. Actions taken: rollback of the new reranker variant, forced prefix/KV caching, and temporary pool increase (+2 nodes).

Result: since mitigations we have P95 ~= 350–420ms and error rate ~0.9% across checkout. That's materially improved but not yet back to baseline. Next steps:
- Continue telemetry sampling on 5m cadence.
- Keep the rollback in place for 2 hours and observe; if stable, we'll plan a controlled rollout with stricter traffic gating.
- Laura to coordinate a customer-facing note to Brightcart CSM + ops (we expect to share a brief in 45 minutes).
- If we do not hit error rate <0.5% within 2 hours we'll open a credit remediation path under HS-38612 and brief leadership.

We appreciate the rapid signals from your SREs — Monica will keep this as the single threaded external contact. Expect next external update by 09:45 PT or earlier if anything changes.

— Jonas Weber
Director, Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference
